description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifierFilterXmp which extends HTMLPurifier_Filter. It provides a preFilter method that replaces <xmp> tags with <pre> tags in HTML content.

classes.name: HTMLPurifierFilterXmp
classes.description: A filter class that replaces <xmp> HTML tags with <pre> tags to sanitize or standardize HTML content.

methods.name: preFilter
methods.description: Replaces <xmp> tags with <pre> tags in the given HTML string using a regular expression.
